title: Business Council of Australia more aligned with fossil fuel industry than its members’ values, analysis finds
summary_full: Research by InfluenceMap raises questions about association’s policies and representation, particularly around advocacy for new gas suppliesGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThe Business Council of Australia is lobbying for gas expansion policies that clash with the climate concerns of the majority of its own members, according to new research that raises questions about the sway of a handful of major companies.The business association also does not publicly disclose who is on its energy and climate committee, prompting transparency concerns among researchers over how its policies are shaped and whose interests they represent.
